propositions: The deprecated resolved_statuses config keys (jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses) are now inert and no longer read by any code; operator approval has been given to remove them entirely.

Both schema fields and their _as_str_list coercers must be deleted from _config_schema.py, and deprecation rows must be replaced with warn-class tombstones in _deprecations.py to allow existing configs to load with a warning rather than fail.
The auto-derived environment variable twins (REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES and REBAR_RECONCILER_RESOLVED_STATUSES) must be added as warn-class tombstones since they are valid real usable inputs.
Documentation references to resolved_statuses must be removed from config.md, user-guide.md, release-notes.md, and CHANGELOG.md.
All configuration gates, module-size constraints, and test assertions must be verified to ensure no orphaned # read-via: markers remain and module size stays within limits.
